answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a ledge bet on surviving 81 epochs of grading, and every nadir settlement recomputes the jade schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 81 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 35 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
